Honestly, yes — from my point of view that's the same page. If the only difference is some newsletter tracking gunk tacked on the end, or it jumps to a section partway down, it's still the same article I already saved, so I'd rather it recognize it and show me "already saved" instead of quietly making a near-identical duplicate. That kind of clutter is exactly what I'm trying to avoid.

That said, I know that's a finer detail than the core promise, and I don't want to hold things up over getting every variation perfect. If it's easy to catch the obvious cases like tracking tags and section jumps, that would be a nice touch; if some slip through occasionally, it's not a dealbreaker for me.
